# Routing validation scenarios

1. A brand-new project with scattered notes should route to `lightspeed-project-intake`.
2. A project with a stable PRD and missing sizing should route to `lightspeed-estimation-planner`.
3. A project in QA with concrete findings should route to `lightspeed-qa-triage`.
4. A mid-project stakeholder request that changes scope should route to `lightspeed-change-control`.
5. A launch-ready project with known issues should route to `lightspeed-release-handoff-generator`.
